semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: International health and global health outreach are closely related, as both involve efforts to improve health outcomes and services across borders.

parent_domains.justification: Global health is a broad domain that encompasses various initiatives, including outreach programs aimed at improving health outcomes worldwide.
Public health is a broader domain that includes global health outreach as it aims to improve health at the community and international levels.
This domain implies a combination of global health initiatives which may include outreach efforts, policy-making, and surgical practices across countries.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Global health is the most directly related domain, as it encompasses the idea of improving health outcomes on a global scale, which is precisely what global health outreach aims to achieve.

child_domains.justification: This domain could be a specific area within global health outreach if the outreach focuses on integrating digital solutions.
Health informatics can be part of outreach efforts to manage health information and improve decision-making processes.
Community-based initiatives are often a component of global health outreach efforts focused on improving health care access at a local level.

closest_child_domain.justification: Community-based primary health care aligns closely with outreach activities that aim to improve health services and access at the grassroots level, often a key component of global health outreach.

sibling_domains.justification: Both global health outreach and global surgery involve efforts to improve health outcomes globally, often sharing resources and strategies.
This domain and global health outreach both focus on overall health outcomes at the population level.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Global surgery is closely related because both involve global efforts to improve health outcomes and can include outreach components.

unrelated_domains.justification: While AI can be a tool used within outreach, it is not specifically focused on global health outreach.
Biomedicine is more about the study and application of biological and physiological principles in medicine and less related to health outreach.
Digital health focuses more on the technological integration in health care rather than outreach efforts.
While related to health services, patient care does not specifically focus on outreach.
